parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the fan assembly consisting of multiple blades attached to a central hub, made of aluminum for lightweight and durability.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to circulate air, providing cooling and ventilation when powered by the motor.
parts.Movement_description: The fan blades rotate around the central axis when the motor is activated, converting electrical energy into mechanical airflow.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or mounting structure of the fan, typically made of steel for strength and stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the fan assembly and houses the motor, ensuring the fan remains securely attached to the ceiling or mounting surface.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary, providing a stable axis for the rotating fan blades.
